tool.help:
NCBI EGAPx prepare input ========================
What it does ============
Downloads the data that an `EGAPx <https://github.com/ncbi/egapx>`_ run needs (EGAPx ``--download-needed``) into an **EGAPx local cache** dataset: the EGAPx support data and BUSCO lineage files for the taxid, plus SRA reads when they are listed in the configuration. It does not run the annotation.
Configure the run with the tool form (the generated **EGAPx configuration** YAML is also output), or supply an EGAPx YAML configuration from your history.
Then run **NCBI EGAPx execute** with the same YAML configuration and the local cache. This splits the download from the long annotation run and makes the annotation reproducible. To download and annotate in one step, use **NCBI EGAPx**.
@HELP_COMMON@
